bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for the redevelopment of vacant GFW school district properties in the cities of Gibbon, Fairfax, and Winthrop.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; GFW SCHOOL DISTRICT VACANT PROPERTY REDEVELOPMENT.

$3,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for one or more grants to the city of Gibbon, the city of Fairfax, the city of Winthrop, or a combination of one or more of these cities to predesign and design the redevelopment of properties formerly occupied by Independent School District No. 2365, GFW, to repurpose the properties to meet the needs of the communities in which the properties are located. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
